description: This file defines the 'MyGLSurfaceView' class, a custom view for rendering OpenGL ES graphics and handling touch events in an Android application.

classes.name: MyGLSurfaceView
classes.description: A custom GLSurfaceView that manages an OpenGL renderer and handles touch inputs to rotate the displayed object.

methods.name: MyGLSurfaceView
methods.description: Constructor initializes the GLSurfaceView, sets the renderer, and configures the render mode.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input events to adjust the rendering based on user interaction.
